abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Browse and Navigate Featured Collections on Home Page
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case: 1

Test Case Title: Browse and Navigate Featured Collections on Home Page
Module: Home Page - Featured Collections
Priority: High

Preconditions:
- User is on the Home Page of the jewelry shopping website.
- Featured collections are configured and available.

Test Steps:
1. Scroll through the Home Page to locate the featured collections section.
2. Observe the list of featured collections displayed.
3. Click on a collection title or image within the featured collections section.
4. Verify that the user is navigated to the respective collection page.
5. Observe the collection page for detailed information about the selected collection.

Expected Result:
- The featured collections list is visible and can be scrolled.
- Each collection displays a title and image.
- Clicking a collection title or image navigates to the correct collection page.
- The collection page displays more details about the selected collection.

- Options to view more information or initiate a return for the selected order are available.

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Verify management of items in the shopping bag
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case: 1

Test Case Title: Verify management of items in the shopping bag

Module: Shopping Bag

Priority: High

Preconditions:
- User is logged into the app
- User has added at least two items to the shopping bag

Test Steps:
1. Click the shopping bag icon from any page in the app.
2. Verify that the shopping bag page displays all selected items.
3. Change the quantity of one item in the shopping bag.
4. Remove one item from the shopping bag.
5. Review the updated list of items and their quantities in the shopping bag.
6. Click the "Proceed to Checkout" button.

Expected Result:
- The shopping bag page displays all currently selected items, each with options to modify quantity and remove the item.
- The quantity change is reflected immediately for the relevant item.
- The removed item no longer appears in the shopping bag.
- The user can proceed to the checkout page from the shopping bag page without errors.

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case: 1

Test Case Title: Verify accessibility and functionality of the size guide on product details page

Preconditions:
- User is on the product details page of a ring.
- Product details page is fully loaded.

Test Steps:
1. Click the 'Size Guide' link or button on the product details page.
2. Select the 'Measure My Finger' option in the size guide.
3. Observe and read the instructions displayed for measuring finger size.
4. Select the 'Measure My Own Ring' option in the size guide.
5. Observe and read the instructions displayed for measuring an existing ring.
6. Check if a size chart is visible and accessible in the size guide.

Expected Result:
- Size guide opens clearly and overlays or navigates from the product details page.
- Both 'Measure My Finger' and 'Measure My Own Ring' options are selectable.
- Clear instructions are displayed for each selected option.
- A visible and clear size chart is provided to help determine the ring size.

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Update Account Information and Save Changes
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case: 1

Test Case Title: Update Account Information and Save Changes
Module: Account Settings
Priority: High

Preconditions:
- User is registered and logged into the application.
- User has access to any screen within the application.

Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the account settings page from the current screen.
2. Verify that the account settings page displays the user's name, email, and password fields.
3. Update the name field with a new valid name.
4. Update the email field with a new valid email address.
5. Update the password field with a new valid password.
6. Click the Save Changes button.
7. Confirm any prompts or messages requesting confirmation to save changes.
8. Verify that a success message is displayed after saving.
9. Navigate away from the account settings page and return to it.
10. Verify that the updated name, email, and password are displayed correctly.

Expected Result:
- The account settings page is accessible from any screen.
- The user's current personal information is displayed in the respective fields.
- The system accepts and saves all valid changes.
- A success message is displayed after saving.
- Updated information persistently appears when revisiting the account settings page.
